title: Vanilla Rebirth
description: A richer vanilla experience — fully compatible with vanilla servers.
body:
## Vanilla Rebirth
Are you being forced to play vanilla Minecraft by your friends who don't want to play with mods? Or you just want to play vanilla but want a modernized look? Well, in any case, you should try **Vanilla Rebirth**!

Vanilla Rebirth is a **client-side modpack** which is perfectly compatible with all vanilla clients and servers. 
- ✨ Modern animations (Fresh Animations, Hold My Items);
- 👀 Modern UI (Blur+, Smooth GUI, Immersive Hotbar, Chat Animation);
- 😊 QoL (Jade, Xaero's mods, Client Sort, LambDynamicLights);
- ⚡ Optimization
And much more...

The included resource packs are all **auto-loaded** thanks to the [Simple Resource Loader](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-resource-loader) mod by Patbox. Included Resource Packs:

- [Bushier Bushes](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bushier-bushes) by MegaNecra
- [Better Foliage Add-On](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-foliage-add-on) by Nico4play
- [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) (+ [Emissive](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-emissive) and [Player](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension) extensions)
- [Glowing Items](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowing-items) by AndrewHG
- [Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reimagined) by Reijvi
- [Connected Paths](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/connected-paths) by Jacosvaldo
- [(Bee's) Fluffy Carpets and Wool](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fluffy-carpets) by bebebea_loste
- [Fresh Food](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-food) by cyber
- [Mace but 3D](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mace-but-3d-resourcepack) by Volery
- [3D Harnesses x Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/3d-harnesses-x-fresh-animations) by Mtcd
- [Visual: Armor Trims](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/visual-armor-trims) by thanos
- [3D crops Revamped](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/3d-crops) by vexcenot
- [Leaf Litter Plus](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/leaf-litter-plus) by 1111w
- [Glowing 3D Totem](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowing-3d-totem) by tixork
- [Glowing 3D Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/glowing-3d-armor) by tixork

**_Rediscover vanilla’s beauty without altering gameplay._**
